PGM_REASON: RICKYINE from Cross Oil (Smackover AR) has caused significant mixer downtime in nearly every GY NA plant (including at least FAY, LAW, TOP, DAN, NAP, MH, VF) due to excessive clogging of transfer pipes and filters between the holding tanks and the individual point-of-use mixers.  Estimated mixer downtime in the region exceeds 100 hours in the last year.  Additional cost impact of the Cross Oil issues include a new holding tank, new piping in multiple plants, a roughly 100-fold increase in filter changing, etc.  A final root cause has not yet been identified, but the ubiquity of issues across multiple transloaders, countries, and tire plants indicates that the issue is with the source material.  RICKYINE is supplied by Ergon (Vicksburg MS) to other GY NA plants including FAY and TOP with no issues observed that are qualitatively similar to the Cross Oil issues.  Napanee chosen as the initial SC due to high-impact shutdown events.
